_meta.description: Seed food database for the Pancreas-Friendly Eating Companion. Fat values are approximate, drawn from standard nutrition references, and vary by brand, cut, and preparation. Treat every number as an estimate.
_meta.disclaimer: General information only. Not medical or dietetic advice. Your care team's instructions always win.

foods.name: Chicken breast, skinless, baked or grilled
modifications: Ask for it cooked dry, or with broth or cooking spray instead of oil or butter
Skip any finishing butter, compound butter, or oil drizzle
foods.notes: The single most reliable order at almost any restaurant in America.

foods.name: Chicken breast, roasted with skin on
modifications: Remove the skin before eating and this drops to about 3.5 grams
foods.notes: The skin is nearly all of the fat here.

foods.name: Chicken thigh, skinless
modifications: Swap to breast meat for roughly one third the fat

foods.name: Fried chicken, breaded
modifications: Air fryer versions with a light breading run around 5 to 6 grams
Oven-baked with cornflake crumbs and cooking spray gets close to the texture
foods.notes: One of the hardest ones to give up. The air fryer version is genuinely good.

foods.name: Chicken wings, fried
modifications: Grilled or baked wings with sauce on the side run about 12 grams
Buffalo sauce itself is low fat; the butter usually cut into it is not

foods.name: Turkey breast, skinless, roasted
foods.notes: Even leaner than chicken breast.

foods.name: Ground turkey, 99% fat free
modifications: Add sauteed onion, garlic, and a little broth for moisture, since there is no fat to carry flavor
foods.notes: The workhorse substitution for ground beef in almost any recipe.

foods.name: Ground turkey, 85% lean
modifications: Check the package. 99% fat free looks nearly identical on the shelf and has one tenth the fat
foods.notes: Not all ground turkey is lean. This is the common trap.

foods.name: Rotisserie chicken, skin removed
modifications: Stick to white meat and remove all skin
Many are basted in butter or oil, so rinse or blot if you can
foods.notes: Convenient, but higher than plain baked chicken because of the baste.

foods.name: Chicken nuggets, fast food
modifications: Grilled chicken strips at the same restaurant usually run 3 to 5 grams

foods.name: Chicken salad, made with mayonnaise
modifications: Made with nonfat Greek yogurt and mustard instead of mayo, this drops to about 3 grams
Add celery, grapes, and a little dill so it does not taste like a compromise
foods.notes: A great example of a food that is fine and a preparation that is not.

foods.name: Cod, baked or broiled
modifications: Ask for it cooked with lemon and broth instead of butter

foods.name: Shrimp, steamed or grilled
modifications: Ask for no butter in the steamer and no butter drizzle
Cocktail sauce is fat free; drawn butter is 11 grams per tablespoon

foods.name: Fried shrimp
modifications: Grilled or steamed shrimp at the same restaurant is nearly always available

foods.name: Salmon, baked
modifications: A 2 oz portion runs about 6 grams and still counts as a real serving of fish
Sockeye is leaner than farmed Atlantic
foods.notes: Nutritionally excellent fat, but still fat your pancreas has to process. Portion matters more than usual here.

foods.name: Canned tuna, packed in oil
modifications: Buy water packed instead. Same price, one eighth the fat

foods.name: Tuna salad with mayonnaise
modifications: Nonfat Greek yogurt plus a squeeze of lemon and chopped pickle brings this to about 2 grams

foods.name: Crab meat, steamed
modifications: The crab is fine. The drawn butter is the problem. Use Old Bay and vinegar instead

foods.name: Fish sticks, fried
modifications: Oven-baked versions run about 8 grams; air fried from frozen runs lower still

foods.name: Catfish, fried
modifications: Cornmeal-dredged and air fried with cooking spray gets you most of the way there for about 6 grams

foods.name: Ground beef, 93% lean
modifications: Brown it, then rinse the crumbles in hot water in a colander. This removes several more grams
99% fat free ground turkey substitutes cleanly in chili, tacos, and sauce

foods.name: Ground beef, 80% lean
modifications: This is most of a day's budget in one patty

foods.name: Sirloin steak, trimmed
modifications: Order a 4 oz or 6 oz cut rather than the 12 oz
Ask for no butter finish, which steakhouses add by default
foods.notes: If steak is happening, sirloin or filet trimmed is the way.

foods.name: Ribeye steak
modifications: Sirloin or filet is roughly one third the fat for the same experience

foods.name: Pork tenderloin, roasted
foods.notes: The leanest common cut of pork by a wide margin.

foods.name: Pork chop, center cut, trimmed
modifications: Trim the fat cap before cooking, not after

foods.name: Bacon
modifications: Center cut bacon cooked crisp and blotted runs about 4 grams for 2 slices
Turkey bacon runs about 4 grams
Smoked paprika or a dash of liquid smoke gives you the flavor with none of the fat
foods.notes: Small portions are workable. The trouble is that nobody eats two slices.

foods.name: Pork sausage patty
modifications: Turkey sausage runs about 6 grams
Season 99% fat free ground turkey with sage, thyme, black pepper, and a pinch of red pepper for a homemade version at about 2 grams

foods.name: Hot dog, beef
modifications: Fat free hot dogs exist and are about 0 grams. They are better than they sound

foods.name: Deli turkey breast
foods.notes: Reliable sandwich base. The problem is always the mayo and cheese, not the turkey.

foods.name: Bologna
modifications: Fat free bologna is sold in most grocery stores

foods.name: Pepperoni
modifications: Turkey pepperoni runs about 4 grams and crisps up the same way

foods.name: Beef brisket, smoked
modifications: Ask for the lean end rather than the point, and no burnt ends. That gets it near 10 grams

foods.name: Pulled pork with sauce
modifications: Pulled chicken breast with the same sauce runs about 4 grams
Vinegar-based sauce is essentially fat free; creamy or mayo-based sauces are not

foods.name: Egg whites
modifications: Cook in a nonstick pan with cooking spray, not butter

foods.name: Egg, whole
modifications: One whole egg plus two whites gives you the color and richness at about 5 grams total
foods.notes: All of the fat is in the yolk.

foods.name: Scrambled eggs cooked in butter
modifications: Ask for them cooked with cooking spray, dry, or on the flat top with no butter
Restaurants also often add cream. Ask for no cream
foods.notes: The butter usually doubles the fat. Always ask.

foods.name: Black beans
modifications: Rinse canned beans well to cut sodium
foods.notes: Excellent when stable. Go easy during a flare, when high fiber can be uncomfortable.

foods.name: Tofu, firm
modifications: Bake or air fry rather than pan fry in oil

foods.name: Hummus
modifications: Homemade with less tahini and more bean liquid runs about 2 grams
White bean dip with lemon and herbs is a lower fat cousin

foods.name: Peanut butter
modifications: Powdered peanut butter mixed with water runs about 1.5 grams and tastes close in oatmeal or smoothies
If you use the real thing, measure it. A knife-swipe is rarely one tablespoon
foods.notes: Measure this one. Eyeballing nut butter is the most common way people blow a daily budget.

foods.name: Almonds
modifications: A 6 to 8 nut portion runs about 4 grams if you want the crunch

foods.name: Whole milk
modifications: Skim milk in coffee, cereal, and cooking is a nearly invisible swap

foods.name: Greek yogurt, nonfat, plain
foods.notes: The most useful single item in a low fat kitchen. Replaces sour cream, mayonnaise, cream cheese, and heavy cream in most applications.

foods.name: Whole milk yogurt
modifications: Nonfat Greek is thicker and higher in protein anyway

foods.name: Cheddar cheese
modifications: A half ounce of very sharp cheddar delivers more flavor than an ounce of mild, at half the fat
Fat free cheddar melts poorly but works fine cold on a sandwich

foods.name: Fat free cheese
modifications: Melts better if you add a splash of skim milk and low heat

foods.name: Mozzarella, part skim
foods.notes: The lowest fat of the common melting cheeses.

foods.name: Cream cheese
modifications: Fat free cream cheese is a direct swap on a bagel
Whipped versions cut fat roughly in half by volume

foods.name: Sour cream
modifications: Nonfat Greek yogurt is nearly indistinguishable on a baked potato or in a dip

foods.name: Butter
modifications: Fat free butter spray gives you the flavor at 0 grams
Fat free chicken broth adds moisture to vegetables and potatoes in place of butter
Apple butter on toast instead of butter is a genuinely good trade
foods.notes: The single most common hidden fat in restaurant food. Ask about it every time.

foods.name: Heavy cream
modifications: Evaporated skim milk thickened with a little cornstarch makes a workable cream sauce base

foods.name: Half and half
modifications: Skim milk or a nonfat creamer in coffee

foods.name: Ice cream
modifications: Sorbet and Italian ice are fat free
Nonfat frozen yogurt runs 0 to 1 gram
Fudge pops and fruit bars are usually under 2 grams

foods.name: Frozen yogurt, nonfat
modifications: Skip the candy toppings; go with fruit

foods.name: String cheese
modifications: Light string cheese runs about 2.5 grams

foods.name: White rice, cooked
foods.notes: Gentle, filling, and easy on the system. A flare-week staple.

foods.name: Brown rice, cooked
modifications: Switch to white rice during a flare when fiber is harder to handle

foods.name: Pasta, cooked, plain
modifications: The pasta is never the problem. The sauce is

foods.name: Bagel, plain
modifications: Fat free cream cheese or apple butter instead of butter or regular cream cheese

foods.name: Croissant
modifications: A bagel or English muffin scratches a similar itch for about 1.5 grams
foods.notes: Laminated pastry is layers of butter by definition.

foods.name: Saltine crackers
foods.notes: A reliable friend on a bad stomach day.

foods.name: Pretzels
foods.notes: The crunchy salty snack that actually works.

foods.name: Potato chips
modifications: Baked chips run about 3 grams
Pretzels or air-popped popcorn are lower still

foods.name: Popcorn, air popped, no butter
modifications: Fat free butter spray plus salt, or nutritional yeast for a cheesy note

foods.name: Baked potato, plain
modifications: Top with nonfat Greek yogurt, chives, salsa, or fat free butter spray
foods.notes: Available at almost every restaurant, and green until it meets butter and sour cream.

foods.name: Mashed potatoes with butter and milk
modifications: Made with skim milk and fat free chicken broth instead of butter and cream, this drops to about 1 gram and still tastes like mashed potatoes

foods.name: French fries
modifications: Oven or air fried potato wedges with cooking spray and paprika run about 3 grams
Ask for a baked potato or apple slices as the side swap; most places allow it free

foods.name: Sweet potato, baked
modifications: Cinnamon and a little brown sugar instead of butter

foods.name: Hash browns, fried
modifications: Ask for them dry on the flat top, which some diners will do

foods.name: Oatmeal made with water or skim milk
modifications: Berries, cinnamon, and a little brown sugar rather than butter or cream

foods.name: Grits, plain
modifications: Salt, pepper, and fat free butter spray

foods.name: Grits with butter and cheese
modifications: Fat free sharp cheddar plus fat free butter spray gets you close for about 1 gram

foods.name: Flour tortilla
modifications: Corn tortillas run under 1 gram
Low fat or fat free flour tortillas are widely sold

foods.name: Pancakes
modifications: Ask for no butter on top; that alone saves 11 grams
Made at home with skim milk, egg whites, and cooking spray, two pancakes run about 2 grams

foods.name: Waffle, plain
modifications: No butter, syrup only

foods.name: Broccoli, steamed, no butter
modifications: Always specify no butter. Restaurants butter vegetables by default

foods.name: Spinach, cooked
modifications: Saute in broth or with cooking spray, not oil

foods.name: Collard greens, cooked plain
modifications: Smoked turkey wing or a dash of liquid smoke gives you the smoky depth without fatback

foods.name: Corn on the cob, no butter
modifications: Lime, chili powder, and salt instead of butter

foods.name: Salad greens, plain
modifications: The greens are free. The dressing, cheese, croutons, bacon, and nuts are the whole cost

foods.name: Coleslaw with mayonnaise
modifications: Vinegar slaw runs under 1 gram and is the traditional style across much of Appalachia anyway

foods.name: Zucchini sauteed in oil
modifications: Zucchini is a sponge. Saute in broth with garlic instead

foods.name: Avocado
modifications: A few thin slices, about 1/8 of an avocado, runs under 4 grams
foods.notes: Healthy fat is still fat your pancreas has to process.

foods.name: Mushrooms sauteed in broth
foods.notes: Deep savory flavor with no fat. Useful in place of meat in sauces.

foods.name: Apple
modifications: Peel it during a flare if raw fiber bothers you

foods.name: Banana
foods.notes: Gentle, portable, and reliable on a rough day.

foods.name: Applesauce, unsweetened
modifications: Also works as a fat replacement in baking, cup for cup, in place of oil

foods.name: Watermelon
foods.notes: Also counts toward hydration.

foods.name: Canned peaches in juice
modifications: Choose juice packed rather than heavy syrup

foods.name: Mayonnaise
modifications: Mustard is 0 grams
Nonfat Greek yogurt with lemon works in salads
Fat free mayo exists and is fine mixed into things, if not spread plain
foods.notes: A sandwich with mayo on both slices is 20 grams before you add anything else.

foods.name: Ranch dressing
modifications: Order it on the side and dip the fork, not the food. That alone cuts it by two thirds
Fat free ranch is 0 grams
Nonfat Greek yogurt with dill, garlic powder, and buttermilk powder makes a real one
foods.notes: A dressed salad can carry more fat than a cheeseburger. Always on the side.

foods.name: Balsamic vinaigrette
modifications: Plain balsamic vinegar with no oil is 0 grams and plenty flavorful

foods.name: Olive oil
modifications: Measure it. Never pour from the bottle
Cooking spray delivers the nonstick benefit at essentially 0 grams
foods.notes: Good fat, but a tablespoon is a third to half of a whole day's budget.

foods.name: Cooking spray
foods.notes: NPF specifically recommends this in place of oils.

foods.name: Brown gravy
modifications: Made from fat free broth thickened with cornstarch, this is under 1 gram

foods.name: Barbecue sauce
foods.notes: One of the few big-flavor sauces that is essentially fat free.

foods.name: Honey mustard dressing
modifications: Plain mustard whisked with honey and lemon juice is fat free and tastes better

foods.name: Salsa
modifications: Go mild during a flare

foods.name: Guacamole
modifications: Salsa or pico de gallo gives you the fresh brightness at 0 grams

foods.name: Tartar sauce
modifications: Nonfat Greek yogurt with relish, lemon, and dill is a close match at under 1 gram

foods.name: Chicken broth, fat free
foods.notes: Cooking liquid, flavor base, and flare-day food all in one.

foods.name: Vegetable soup, broth based
modifications: Confirm it is broth based and not cream based before ordering

foods.name: Cream of mushroom soup
modifications: 98% fat free condensed versions run about 1 gram and work fine in casseroles
A broth base thickened with cornstarch and pureed mushrooms is a good scratch version

foods.name: Potato soup, cream based
modifications: Pureed potato with fat free broth and skim milk is naturally creamy at about 1 gram

foods.name: Chili made with lean ground turkey
modifications: 99% fat free turkey and no cheese topping brings this to about 2 grams

foods.name: Beef stew
modifications: Made with trimmed round and skimmed after chilling, this drops to about 5 grams
Chill overnight and lift the solidified fat off the top before reheating

foods.name: Soup beans, cooked plain
modifications: Smoked turkey wing or a few drops of liquid smoke in place of fatback or a ham hock gives you the same depth
Onion, garlic, bay leaf, and black pepper carry a lot of the flavor on their own
foods.notes: A cornerstone Appalachian meal that works beautifully on a low fat diet as long as it is not cooked with pork fat.

foods.name: Soup beans cooked with fatback or ham hock
modifications: Smoked turkey wing is the standard swap and most people cannot tell the difference

foods.name: Cornbread
modifications: Made with skim buttermilk, egg whites, applesauce in place of the oil, and a sprayed skillet, this runs about 1.5 grams
Skip the butter on top; a drizzle of sorghum is fat free

foods.name: Biscuit
modifications: Biscuits are structurally made of fat, so there is no great low fat version
Apple butter or sorghum on a plain roll or English muffin is a reasonable stand-in
foods.notes: Honest answer: this one is hard to fix. Better to spend the budget deliberately on a small one than to chase a substitute.

foods.name: Sausage gravy
modifications: Made with 99% fat free ground turkey seasoned with sage and black pepper, skim milk, and a cornstarch or flour roux with no drippings, this runs about 2 grams per quarter cup
Over an English muffin instead of a biscuit saves another 10 grams
foods.notes: A full plate of biscuits and gravy can run 45 grams or more. The homemade rebuild is genuinely worth doing.

foods.name: Country ham
modifications: Trim the fat edge completely and use it as a seasoning rather than a portion
foods.notes: Very salty as well as fatty. A little goes a long way, which works in your favor here.

foods.name: Green beans cooked with fatback
modifications: Simmer in fat free chicken broth with onion and a dash of liquid smoke instead
foods.notes: The beans are nearly free. The seasoning meat is the whole cost.

foods.name: Collard greens with ham hock
modifications: Smoked turkey wing, apple cider vinegar, and red pepper flakes

foods.name: Fried green tomatoes
modifications: Cornmeal dredged, sprayed, and air fried at 400 degrees runs about 3 grams and keeps the crunch
foods.notes: One of the best air fryer wins available.

foods.name: Fried apples
modifications: Simmer sliced apples with cinnamon, brown sugar, and a splash of apple cider in a sprayed pan. No butter needed, about 0.3 grams

foods.name: Chicken and dumplings
modifications: Skinless breast meat, fat free broth, skim milk, and rolled dumplings made with cooking spray instead of shortening brings this to about 3 grams
foods.notes: Rebuilds well. This is one to keep.

foods.name: Pepperoni roll
modifications: Turkey pepperoni in homemade dough with no added oil runs about 5 grams
Ask for or make one with fewer sticks of pepperoni
foods.notes: West Virginia's contribution to world cuisine. The turkey pepperoni version is a real option.

foods.name: Apple butter
foods.notes: Contains no butter at all. One of the great free wins on a low fat diet.

foods.name: Sorghum syrup
foods.notes: Fat free. Use it where you would have used butter on cornbread or a biscuit.

foods.name: Brunswick stew
modifications: Made with pulled chicken breast rather than pork and skimmed after chilling, about 3 grams

foods.name: Pimento cheese
modifications: Fat free sharp cheddar, fat free cream cheese, pimentos, and a little fat free mayo runs about 1 gram. Texture differs but the flavor lands

foods.name: Banana pudding, traditional
modifications: Fat free instant pudding made with skim milk, real bananas, vanilla wafers, and fat free whipped topping runs about 2 grams
foods.notes: One of the easiest desserts to rebuild almost perfectly.

foods.name: Ramps, sauteed
modifications: Ramps themselves are essentially fat free. Wilt them in broth or roast them with cooking spray instead of frying in bacon grease
foods.notes: The ramps are fine. The bacon grease is the issue.

foods.name: Cheeseburger, fast food
modifications: Plain hamburger with no cheese and no mayo runs about 12 grams
A grilled chicken sandwich with no mayo runs about 8 grams

foods.name: Hamburger, plain, fast food
modifications: Ketchup, mustard, pickle, onion. No mayo, no cheese

foods.name: Grilled chicken sandwich, no mayo, no cheese
modifications: Specify no mayo when ordering. It is applied by default at nearly every chain
foods.notes: The reliable fast food order almost anywhere.

foods.name: Crispy chicken sandwich
modifications: The grilled version of the same sandwich is usually on the same menu

foods.name: Pepperoni pizza
modifications: Thin crust, light cheese, veggie toppings, and blotting the surface oil brings 2 slices to around 10 grams
Order half the cheese. Most places will do it

foods.name: Veggie pizza, thin crust, light cheese
modifications: Blot the top with a napkin. It genuinely removes 2 to 3 grams

foods.name: Fettuccine alfredo
modifications: Pasta with marinara is about 8 grams for the same plate
A homemade alfredo from evaporated skim milk, cornstarch, garlic, and a little real parmesan runs about 5 grams per serving
foods.notes: Often more than a full day of fat in one dish.

foods.name: Spaghetti with marinara
modifications: Ask them to skip the finishing oil and hold the parmesan
Box half before it comes to the table
foods.notes: The reliable Italian restaurant order.

foods.name: Chicken parmigiana
modifications: Grilled chicken with marinara and no cheese gets you the same flavors at about 8 grams
foods.notes: Breaded, fried, and covered in cheese. Three problems at once.

foods.name: General Tso's chicken
modifications: Steamed chicken and vegetables with the sauce on the side is on nearly every Chinese menu, usually under a diet or health section, at about 6 grams

foods.name: Steamed chicken and vegetables, sauce on the side
modifications: Use maybe a third of the sauce packet
foods.notes: Almost every Chinese restaurant has this. Ask for the steamed diet menu.

foods.name: Beef and broccoli, takeout
modifications: Ask for it steamed with sauce on the side, or swap to chicken

foods.name: Burrito bowl, chicken, rice, beans, salsa, no cheese or sour cream or guacamole
modifications: Extra salsa and lettuce make up for skipping the cheese and guacamole
foods.notes: One of the best build-your-own options in fast casual dining.

foods.name: Burrito with cheese, sour cream, and guacamole
modifications: Every add-on is roughly 8 to 10 grams. Dropping all three is most of the difference

foods.name: California roll
modifications: The avocado and any spicy mayo are the fat. Ask for no mayo drizzle

foods.name: Tempura roll
modifications: Any non-tempura, non-spicy-mayo roll is a fraction of this

foods.name: Caesar salad with dressing and croutons
modifications: Grilled chicken over greens with balsamic vinegar on the side and no cheese or croutons runs about 6 grams
foods.notes: A salad is not automatically a safe order. Caesar is one of the highest fat things on most menus.

foods.name: Grilled chicken salad, dressing on the side, no cheese
modifications: Dip the fork tines in the dressing rather than pouring it on

foods.name: Bacon, egg, and cheese biscuit
modifications: Egg white on an English muffin with no cheese and no meat runs about 3 grams
If a chain offers an egg white muffin sandwich, that is usually the lowest fat hot breakfast available anywhere

foods.name: Egg white on an English muffin
Barbecue chicken sandwich, no mayo
modifications: Vinegar slaw on top instead of mayo slaw

foods.name: Angel food cake
modifications: Top with berries and fat free whipped topping
foods.notes: Made from egg whites and sugar. The dessert that actually works.

foods.name: Apple pie
modifications: Baked apples with cinnamon and a crumble of graham crackers gives you the same flavor at about 2 grams
Eat the filling and leave the crust. The crust is nearly all of the fat

foods.name: Chocolate cake
modifications: A boxed cake mix made with applesauce and egg whites instead of oil and whole eggs cuts most of the fat
Cocoa powder is nearly fat free; chocolate chips and frosting are not

foods.name: Spice cake made with pumpkin puree and egg whites
foods.notes: A spice cake mix, a can of pumpkin puree, and three egg whites. No oil, no butter. A widely shared favorite in pancreatitis communities.

foods.name: Gelatin dessert
foods.notes: On the clear liquid list, which makes it useful on the worst days.

foods.name: Pudding, fat free, made with skim milk
Milk chocolate bar
modifications: Chocolate syrup on angel food cake or over fat free frozen yogurt gives you the chocolate at about 0 grams
A fudge pop runs about 1 gram

foods.name: Water
foods.notes: NPF notes that dehydration can trigger a flare. Keep a bottle with you.

foods.name: Coffee, black
modifications: Skim milk or a nonfat creamer instead of cream or half and half

foods.name: Cream or half and half in coffee
modifications: Three cups a day at 2 tablespoons each is 10 grams before you have eaten anything
foods.notes: Small per cup, meaningful per day. Worth switching.

foods.name: Apple juice
foods.notes: On the clear liquid list NPF describes for severe pain days.

foods.name: Electrolyte or sports drink
foods.notes: Useful when keeping fluids down is the main goal.

foods.name: Soda
modifications: Carbonation bothers some people during a flare. Flat ginger ale is a common alternative
foods.notes: No fat, but not a hydration substitute.

foods.name: Milkshake
modifications: Frozen banana blended with skim milk and cocoa powder is close, at under 1 gram
A smoothie made with nonfat yogurt and fruit runs about 0 grams

foods.name: Alcohol of any kind
modifications: Club soda with lime, a mocktail, or a tonic and bitters if you want something that feels like a drink in your hand
foods.notes: The National Pancreas Foundation states that people with pancreatic disease should never drink alcohol. This one is not a fat question, and it does not have a modified version.
